check: bun -e 'import {slugify} from "./src/text"; process.exit(slugify("Hello Wide World")==="hello-wide-world"?0:1)' && bun test 2>&1 | grep -q '0 fail' && test $(bun test 2>&1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+ pass' | grep -oE '[0-9]+') -ge 2
